name: autalo-car-rental
description: Dated car rental offers from local companies, with deposit, insurance and driver terms, and a link to book on autalo.com.

interface.longDescription: Autalo compares dated car rental offers from local companies in supported published destinations. Ask for a car for your dates and pickup place. Search results distinguish live offers from recorded examples. Check a selected car for returned price, deposit, insurance and driver conditions, then request a link to its booking form on autalo.com. Missing terms remain unknown. Booking and payment happen on autalo.com. You can also list supported pickup locations and see recorded monthly prices, with observation dates. Coverage depends on the destination and requested language.
capabilities: Check deposit, insurance and driver terms
Open a booking link on autalo.com
defaultPrompt: Find a car at Tbilisi airport next month
Which pickup places are there in Morocco?
Show recorded monthly rental prices in Batumi

positive.description: List pickup locations in a covered country.
positive.prompt: Which pickup locations does Autalo have in Georgia?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the currently returned pickup places in Georgia and their Autalo page links. Does not invent unavailable locations or a fixed number of places.

positive.description: Dated search with filters and a currency.
positive.prompt: Find an automatic car without a deposit in Batumi for five days starting the 10th of next month, prices in EUR.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches the requested dates, automatic transmission and no-deposit filter in EUR. Reports only returned matching live offers and verified fields. If none match or live data are unavailable, says so; recorded examples never establish current price or availability. Offers the returned Autalo page link.

positive.description: Class and driver age at an airport.
positive.prompt: I need an SUV at Mauritius airport for a week from the 5th of next month. The driver is 23.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches the requested airport, dates, SUV class and driver age. Reports only returned matching offers and verified age conditions. Does not equate class with transmission or promise availability; describes an empty result or recorded fallback accurately.

positive.description: Check one car and open its booking form.
positive.prompt: Search cars at Tbilisi airport from the 12th to the 18th of next month, then check the first one and give me a booking link.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches, checks the first returned car only if one exists, and requests a booking link after checking its returned terms. Explains unknown terms and dated fallback data. A returned Autalo link opens a booking form; it does not reserve a car or take payment. If unavailable, explains the result without fabricating a link or offer.

positive.description: Recorded price guide for a location.
positive.prompt: When is car rental cheapest in Tbilisi and how far ahead should I book?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows returned recorded monthly minimum prices and observation dates, where available. Describes lead-time observations as dated samples only, with no guarantee that booking earlier saves money or secures availability. Missing evidence remains unknown.

negative.prompt: Book me a flight from Berlin to Tbilisi next week.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call Autalo car-rental tools for this request. Answers using general capabilities or another suitable service, and explains any inability to complete the request.

negative.prompt: Recommend a hotel in Marrakech near the medina.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call Autalo car-rental tools for this request. Answers using general capabilities or another suitable service, and explains any inability to complete the request.

negative.description: General writing request unrelated to car rental.
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about a road trip along the coast.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call Autalo car-rental tools for this request. Answers using general capabilities or another suitable service, and explains any inability to complete the request.

review.commerce_description: No purchase or payment happens in ChatGPT. A booking link opens the selected car's booking form on autalo.com.

publication.release_notes: Corrected publisher metadata, review scenarios and dated-data limitations; deterministic packaging and registry checks. MCP service capabilities are unchanged.

ru-RU.subtitle: Аренда авто у местных компаний
ru-RU.description: Autalo помогает найти предложения аренды авто для ваших дат и места получения. Проверьте цену, необходимость залога, страховку и требования к водителю у выбранного предложения, затем откройте форму бронирования на autalo.com. Бронирование и оплата проходят на autalo.com. Также доступны места получения, записанные цены по месяцам и опубликованные советы по аренде.

de-DE.subtitle: Mietwagen lokaler Anbieter
de-DE.description: Autalo findet Mietwagenangebote für Ihre Reisedaten und Ihren Abholort. Prüfen Sie Preis, Kautionspflicht, Versicherung und Fahrerbedingungen des gewählten Angebots und öffnen Sie das Buchungsformular auf autalo.com. Buchung und Zahlung erfolgen auf autalo.com. Sie können auch Abholorte, erfasste Monatspreise und veröffentlichte Mietwagenhinweise ansehen.

es-ES.subtitle: Alquiler de coches locales
es-ES.description: Autalo busca ofertas de alquiler de coches para tus fechas y lugar de recogida. Consulta el precio, si se exige depósito, el seguro y los requisitos del conductor de la oferta elegida y abre su formulario de reserva en autalo.com. La reserva y el pago se realizan en autalo.com. También puedes consultar los puntos de recogida, los precios mensuales registrados y los consejos publicados.

fr-FR.subtitle: Location de voitures locales
fr-FR.description: Autalo recherche des offres de location de voitures pour vos dates et votre lieu de prise en charge. Consultez le prix, le dépôt requis, l’assurance et les conditions du conducteur de l’offre choisie, puis ouvrez son formulaire de réservation sur autalo.com. La réservation et le paiement se font sur autalo.com. Vous pouvez aussi consulter les lieux de prise en charge, les prix mensuels relevés et les conseils publiés.

it-IT.subtitle: Noleggio da aziende locali
it-IT.description: Autalo cerca offerte di noleggio auto per le tue date e il luogo di ritiro. Controlla il prezzo, se è richiesta una cauzione, l’assicurazione e i requisiti del conducente dell’offerta scelta, poi apri il modulo di prenotazione su autalo.com. La prenotazione e il pagamento avvengono su autalo.com. Puoi anche consultare i luoghi di ritiro, i prezzi mensili rilevati e i consigli pubblicati.

pl-PL.subtitle: Wynajem aut od lokalnych firm
pl-PL.description: Autalo wyszukuje oferty wynajmu aut na wybrane daty i miejsce odbioru. Sprawdź cenę, wymóg kaucji, ubezpieczenie i wymagania wobec kierowcy dla wybranej oferty, a następnie otwórz formularz rezerwacji na autalo.com. Rezerwacja i płatność odbywają się na autalo.com. Możesz też sprawdzić miejsca odbioru, zapisane ceny miesięczne i opublikowane porady.
